name: Avatares AI - Admin - Character Canon Ingest Output

workflowId.cachedResultName: Avatares AI - Register Raw Asset Batch - Callable

parameters.jsCode:
const context = $('Download Comfy Output').first().json;
const rows = $input.all().map((item) => item.json || {});
function sql(value) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || String(value).trim() === '') return 'NULL';
  return "'" + String(value).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'";
}
function sqlJson(value) {
  return sql(JSON.stringify(value ?? {})) + '::jsonb';
}
const metadata = {
  referenceIntake: 'characters-console',
  referenceClassification: 'identity-candidate',
  referenceRole: 'identity-candidate',
  registeredFrom: 'canon-portrait-generation',
  generationJobId: context.jobId,
  outputUrl: context.outputUrl,
  comfyFilename: context.comfyFilename,
  comfySubfolder: context.comfySubfolder,
  promptPack: context.promptPack,
  source: 'character-canon-ingest-output',
  registeredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
};
const returnedAssetId = rows.find((item) => item.assetId || item.asset_id)?.assetId || rows.find((item) => item.asset_id)?.asset_id || null;
const assetPredicate = returnedAssetId ? '(asset_id = ' + sql(returnedAssetId) + ' OR sha256 = ' + sql(context.sha256) + ')' : 'sha256 = ' + sql(context.sha256);
const reviewNotes = 'Canon portrait candidate generated from character onboarding.';
const query = `
WITH asset_target AS (
  SELECT * FROM canonical_asset_registry WHERE ${assetPredicate} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
), asset_update AS (
  UPDATE canonical_asset_registry car
  SET
    scene = 'portrait-canon',
    status = 'raw',
    is_canonical = false,
    review_notes = ${sql(reviewNotes)},
    metadata = COALESCE(car.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || ${sqlJson(metadata)}
  FROM asset_target t
  WHERE car.asset_id = t.asset_id
  RETURNING car.*
), generated AS (
  INSERT INTO generated_assets (generated_asset_id, job_id, asset_id, avatar, scene, asset_type, status, review_notes, metadata, created_at, updated_at)
  SELECT gen_random_uuid(), ${sql(context.jobId)}::uuid, asset_id::uuid, avatar, scene, asset_type, 'generated', ${sql(reviewNotes)}, ${sqlJson(metadata)} || jsonb_build_object('assetId', asset_id, 'bucket', bucket, 'objectPath', object_path), now(), now()
  FROM asset_update
  ON CONFLICT (asset_id)
  DO UPDATE SET
    job_id = EXCLUDED.job_id,
    status = 'generated',
    review_notes = EXCLUDED.review_notes,
    metadata = generated_assets.metadata || EXCLUDED.metadata,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING *
), generation_update AS (
  UPDATE generation_jobs
  SET status = 'review_required',
      completed_at = now(),
      updated_at = now(),
      result_payload = COALESCE(result_payload, '{}'::jsonb) || ${sqlJson(metadata)} || jsonb_build_object(
        'assetId', (SELECT asset_id FROM asset_update LIMIT 1),
        'bucket', (SELECT bucket FROM asset_update LIMIT 1),
        'objectPath', (SELECT object_path FROM asset_update LIMIT 1),
        'referenceClassification', 'identity-candidate'
      )
  WHERE job_id = ${sql(context.jobId)}::uuid
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT true AS ok,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'assetId', asset_id,
    'avatar', avatar,
    'scene', scene,
    'classification', metadata->>'referenceClassification',
    'status', status,
    'isCanonical', COALESCE(is_canonical, false),
    'bucket', bucket,
    'objectPath', object_path,
    'url', '/minio/' || bucket || '/' || object_path,
    'reviewNotes', review_notes,
    'createdAt', created_at
  ) AS reference,
  (SELECT row_to_json(generated) FROM generated LIMIT 1) AS generated_asset,
  (SELECT row_to_json(generation_update) FROM generation_update LIMIT 1) AS generation_job
FROM asset_update;
`;
return [{ json: { query } }];
